findings.claim: 20-F 風險因素：數家面板廠具自行設計能力，若客戶成功自研可替代本公司產品的半導體，將減少或停止採購。

findings.excerpt: Moreover, several Panel Manufacturers have in-house design capabilities and therefore may not need to source semiconductor products from us. If our customers successfully develop in-house capabilities to design and develop semiconductors that can substitute for our products, they would likely reduce or stop purchasing our products.

findings.claim: 20-F 競爭章節：產業特徵為持續技術變遷、標準演進與平均售價下滑。
findings.excerpt: The market characteristics for our products are, in general, intensely competitive, characterized by continuous technological change, evolving industry standards, and declining average selling prices.
